description:
Downloads attachments for up to 40 consignments in bulk (returned as zip).
Returns { fileBase64, contentType, sizeBytes }. contentType comes from the response header.

Args:
  - ids (number[]): Array of consignment IDs (max 40)
name: machship_get_attachments_by_consignment_ids
